Application Data.NAME: ABC Tire & Auto Center
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Tire & Auto Center specializes in tire sales and basic automotive maintenance, offering services such as tire inspections, rotations, balancing, oil changes, and battery replacements. Our facility is staffed by well-trained technicians who adhere to documented safety protocols. We prioritize customer safety and satisfaction, ensuring that all operations comply with industry standards. We avoid high-risk services such as towing and salvage, maintaining a secure and environmentally responsible operation. Additionally, we have implemented fire safety measures and limit our inventory to mitigate risks associated with hazardous materials.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a customer experienced a tire blowout while driving on the highway due to a pre-existing defect in the tire that was installed by our technician. The estimated cost of the replacement tire and related services totaled $500. The claim was processed and closed on 06/01/2023, with no further action required.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and alarm systems with 24/7 monitoring, on-site safety training for employees, and routine inspections of fire safety equipment.
